provenance.prompt:
Create a production native PIXEL-ART animation sprite atlas of ADULT SON GOKU from DRAGON BALL Z, matching the attached existing game reference for identity and costume. Black spiky hair, adult athletic martial artist proportions, orange gi over blue undershirt, blue waist sash, blue wristbands, blue boots with yellow/red trim. Same adult size and costume in EVERY cell. No child Goku, no yellow hair, no Super Saiyan, no Kaioken red body, no Ultra Instinct, no Saiyan armor, no tail, no staff, no sword, no gun. Unarmed martial-arts fists, kicks and one-handed palm ki projectiles only. Crisp detailed game pixel art, not a painted illustration. All figures face RIGHT, with natural hip and torso rotation. EXACTLY FOUR equally spaced columns; every row contains FOUR different full-body sequential poses, not shifted copies or glow-only variants. Keep entire black hair spikes, fingers and both boot tips inside their own cell with generous transparent gutters. No sprites overlap cells. Use consistent adult head/body scale between rows. Transparent RGBA background; NO floor, shadow, ground line, painted ledge, scenery, grid lines, labels, numbers, text or borders. No aura around body, no huge energy streaks crossing cells. These are newly drawn project adaptations, not official DBZ animation frames.
Portrait 1:2 canvas, ideally1024x2048. EXACTLY EIGHT ROWS by FOUR COLUMNS, 32 full sprites total. Reserve all eight rows; make each figure compact enough that row8 is fully visible. Four poses in each row, grounded soles at a common row baseline.
ROW1 attackLight1: left straight jab. Guard with left fist near cheek and rear fist tucked → partially extended left arm, lead knee bends → full left punch with hip twist and right fist guarding → elbow retraction and staggered recovery. Four real arm/leg angles.
ROW2 attackLight2: right cross. Rear right fist drawn back and torso rotated left → right shoulder drives forward and rear heel lifts → full right cross at chest height, left fist at cheek, knee lunges → torso counter-rotates and right elbow folds back into guard.
ROW3 attackLight3: rising uppercut. Deep knees and rear fist low at hip → elbow rises in front of chest as legs push upward → right fist high over shoulder with torso straightened → high elbow retracts and weight settles back. No energy blast.
ROW4 crouchLight: low body punch. Deep low guard → left fist strikes forward at waist level with bent knees → opposite shoulder turns into a compact lower body punch, rear fist guards → elbow retracts into a low crouch. All four remain crouched.
ROW5 chargeStart: one-palm Kikoha physical windup, NOT Kamehameha. Upright guard → knees spread and REAR RIGHT HAND OPENS beside chest while other fist guards cheek → body coils back and open right palm draws behind shoulder, elbow bent → deep braced rear stance with open right palm at chest height. Never cup two hands at a hip. No beam or energy sphere yet.
ROW6 chargeLoop: HELD BRACING, not a strike. ALL FOUR keep elbows bent and right palm pulled beside shoulder/chest. Frame1 rear-weighted wide knees, left fist at cheek and right open palm pulled back → frame2 deeper symmetric squat, left forearm guards chest and right elbow tucks → frame3 torso twists further back, lead knee opens and right palm angles up slightly → frame4 elbows rise into compact held guard while rear heel plants. Four distinct anatomical holding poses. No extended punch, projectile or release.
ROW7 chargeRelease: KIKOHA OF SON GOKU, one-handed palm orb, NOT Kamehameha. Frame1 open right palm cocked beside shoulder, knees coiled → frame2 right arm pushes halfway forward, small pale gold orb touching the palm, other fist protects cheek → frame3 full single right palm extended forward with one small round orb just20pixels ahead, hips rotated and front knee lunging → frame4 open palm recoils, elbow bends, torso draws back and legs brace. NO beam, NO two hands together, NO giant aura, NO charging at the hip. Only a small contained orb, no trails outside cell.
ROW8 chargeRecovery: actual recovery after that palm shot. Forward lean and low bent shooting elbow → lead knee bends and open hand closes while feet step inward → torso rises and both fists return before chest → balanced wide boxing guard with relaxed knees. Four different shoulder, elbow and stance positions. Do not omit row6 or merge recovery into release.

nativeCorrections.prompt:
Create a native pixel-art corrective animation sheet of adult Son Goku from DRAGON BALL Z, using the attached game sprite as identity/style reference. Adult athletic build, BLACK spiky hair, ORANGE gi with BLUE undershirt, BLUE sash and wristbands, BLUE boots with yellow trim. Exactly TWO ARMS and TWO HANDS per person, attached naturally to their two shoulders. No extra hand near the face, no doubled forearm. No transformation, aura, weapon, ground, scenery, grid, labels or text. Transparent RGBA background. Landscape2:1 canvas, ideally1024x512. EXACTLY TWO ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS =EIGHT complete full-body sprites, four different anatomical poses per row, equally spaced with generous gutters. Keep both boots, all skin fingers and hair fully inside each cell. Adult proportions and consistent body size.
ROW1 is the missing CHARGE LOOP, FOUR HELD BRACING POSES, not an attack. Every elbow stays BENT and the right open palm stays beside shoulder/chest. No projectile and no orb in this row. Frame1 deep rear-weighted stance, right palm OPEN pulled beside shoulder, left fist by cheek → Frame2 deeper symmetric squat, left forearm protects chest while right open palm lowers beside ribs, elbow still bent → Frame3 lead knee opens and hips twist back, right palm angles upward beside shoulder with elbow folded and left fist stays close to jaw → Frame4 rear heel plants, torso becomes more upright, right forearm folds nearer chest and left elbow rises into compact guard. Four very different knee/hip/elbow postures, sustained charge without any full arm extension or release. NOT Kamehameha: never cup both hands together at a hip.
ROW2 is corrected LEDGE CATCH, using exactly two bare hands and blue wrists against an INVISIBLE ledge, no physical edge painted. Frame1 one right arm reaches upper-right with fingers open, LEFT arm bends down beside ribs, body airborne with knees trailing → Frame2 RIGHT fingers hook edge overhead with that arm stretched, LEFT hand reaches upward toward the same edge with its arm bent IN FRONT of the chest; show ONLY those2arms and NO additional down-hanging fist or forearm → Frame3 BOTH hands grip the invisible edge side by side overhead, TWO arms connect to their shoulders, torso swings inward and knees tuck → Frame4 both gripping elbows bend slightly, torso settles lower and both boots dangle beneath. Exactly two arms in all four figures. Hands visibly gripping and skin fingers readable; not two fists punching the air. Shoulder rotation and knee posture must differ per pose. No ki flight or cloud. This is new generated adapted game art, not official source animation.
nativeCorrections.reason: The initial combat-a source has seven rows and omits chargeLoop. Initial ledgeCatch frame1 visibly contains a third arm/hand; that row is replaced natively, not erased or repainted by code.
